$comment: The model registry and routing policy. Models are data: add or adjust one in your own ~/.claude/model-router.json, or per project in .claude/model-router.json (same shape, merged key by key). strength, speed and cost are relative ranks, not prices. A model's name must be an alias the Agent tool accepts. Crew models must match each agent's frontmatter; the tests check that.

haiku.use_for: Lookups, file search, summarizing known code, running a command and reporting, formatting, trivial edits.

sonnet.use_for: Everyday implementation: features and fixes with a clear spec, tests, refactors inside one module.

opus.use_for: Design and planning, cross-module changes, subtle bugs, security-sensitive code, adversarial review.

fable.use_for: The hardest and longest work: ambiguous multi-system problems, large migrations, research-grade debugging.

verifier.role: Runs tests, lint and type checks and reports results

docs-researcher.role: Reads current Claude Code docs and changelog

implementer.role: Writes code and tests to a clear spec

architect.role: Plans changes and designs systems, read-only
